title: 8 Things to Know About the iPhone Duo
gist: Apple's first foldable, the $1,999 iPhone Duo, arrives seven years after Samsung's Galaxy Fold and is back-ordered for several weeks. It has a 5.4-inch outer screen and a 7.6-inch inner screen and swaps Face ID for Touch ID. Many third-party apps are not yet optimized for it, and MagSafe wallets and docks do not fit its shape well. An inner-display crack costs $999 to repair without AppleCare+, and Reachability and USB-C Apple Pencil support are coming in later updates.

insights.claim: The iPhone Duo is Apple's first folding smartphone. It costs $1,999 and arrives seven years after Samsung pioneered the category with the Galaxy Fold, and WIRED calls it a "pretty dang good foldable" thanks to Apple's long private refinement of the hardware.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Apple entering foldables at a $1,999 price legitimizes the category and pressures Samsung's lead.
insights.quote: That gave Apple plenty of time to refine the hardware behind closed doors rather than in public view—and the results show
insights.locator: The iPhone Duo is finally here.

insights.claim: The iPhone Duo is back-ordered for several weeks.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: The backlog is an early sign of strong demand or constrained supply, worth tracking for Apple's iPhone revenue mix and its suppliers.
insights.quote: It might be a good thing that the Duo is back-ordered for several weeks.
insights.locator: It might be a good thing that the Duo

insights.claim: Repairing a cracked iPhone Duo inner display costs $999 without AppleCare+. Replacing a damaged nano-texture finish costs $19, or $49 out of warranty.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: High repair costs give Apple a strong reason to push AppleCare+ attach rates and services revenue.
insights.locator: If you scratch or damage the nano-texture finish

insights.claim: The iPhone Duo drops Face ID for a side-mounted Touch ID sensor, likely because the Face ID hardware takes too much space in the thin device. It is the first flagship iPhone with Touch ID since Face ID replaced it, and the Dynamic Island moves to the top-right edge.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Thin designs force component trade-offs, and suppliers of Face ID modules lose content on this model.
insights.quote: (Likely because Face ID tech takes up too much space in the thin iPhone Duo.)

insights.claim: The iPhone Duo's shorter, unevenly weighted shape means MagSafe wallets stick out past the lower edge and the unfolded phone tips sideways on magnetic docks. Users will need third-party accessories such as anti-rotation magnet mounts.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: The Duo creates a new upgrade cycle for third-party iPhone accessory makers.
insights.locator: You Need a New MagSafe Wallet

insights.claim: The iPhone Duo's 7.6-inch inner display has a nano-texture matte finish that Apple calls integral and warns users not to remove. Apple says nothing about third-party screen protectors, which could compromise display performance.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Durability of the inner display is a key risk for foldable adoption and for warranty costs.
insights.locator: But for the 7.6-inch matte inner screen

insights.claim: Many third-party apps are not yet optimized for the iPhone Duo's 5.4-inch outer and 7.6-inch inner screens and display with black side bars. Slack, Instagram, DoorDash and WhatsApp have optimized for iOS 27.1, though Instagram still shows UI glitches.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: How quickly developers adopt the new screens will determine how good the foldable experience is and how fast the category grows.
insights.quote: It will take time for every app in your library to work perfectly across these new screens.
insights.locator: Apple apps, redesigned for the Duo

insights.claim: Apple will add Reachability, which shifts apps left or right on the wide inner screen, and support for the USB-C Apple Pencil (only that model) to the iPhone Duo in software updates later this year. The Duo has no built-in place to store the stylus.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Stylus support on the Duo blurs the line between iPhone and iPad, which could cannibalize iPad mini.
insights.quote: Apple will bring support for the USB-C Apple Pencil (and only that Apple Pencil model, not others) in a software update later this year.

insights.claim: iPhone Duo software features include split-screen app pairs, a split keyboard, rear-camera selfies previewed on the outer screen, Duo Preview to show subjects the viewfinder, and Kids Cue Snoopy animations on the outer screen.
insights.speaker: Julian Chokkattu
insights.so_what: Apple's foldable-specific features are now on par with Android foldables.
